name: sen_sero
description: Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serotyping panel (gspec-curated INSDC CDS markers)
license: INSDC sequence data (public; no redistribution restriction)
note: O-antigen/H-antigen markers extracted from annotated RefSeq CDS (NC_003197.2 Typhimurium LT2, NC_011294.1 Enteritidis P125109, NC_006511.1 Paratyphi A ATCC 9150, NC_003198.1 Typhi CT18); serotype.json applies the curated serovar rules with measured thresholds (scripts/salmonella/README.md). Subsp. enterica only: the other subspecies cannot be separated by antigen genes.

references.citation: Zhang S, Yin Y, Jones MB, et al. Salmonella serotype determination utilizing high-throughput genome sequencing data. J Clin Microbiol. 2015;53(5):1685-1692.
references.note: SeqSero: the O/H gene approach this panel follows.

references.citation: Yoshida CE, Kruczkiewicz P, Laing CR, et al. The Salmonella In Silico Typing Resource (SISTR): an open web-accessible tool for rapidly typing and subtyping draft microbial genomes. PLoS One. 2016;11(8):e0160528.
references.note: SISTR: serovar nomenclature and validation reference.

caveats: Gene panel only: O:2 (group A) and O:9 (group D1) are not separated by presence markers (rfc 98.5-99.9% and rfbS 98.5-99.3% identical across groups); the definitive O call needs an rfb-locus cluster stage.
Paratyphi A is provisional: its rule excludes the D1 rfbE allele, which that serovar may carry as a pseudogene.
Vi antigen (tviB/tviC) is not screened, so Typhi reports 9,12:d:- rather than asserting Vi.
Only subsp. enterica is typed by design; the other subspecies need biochemical differentiation.
